name: INGS inc.
summary: INGS inc. manages restaurants and produces franchises through Ramen and Restaurant segments. The ramen business consists mainly of directly run stores such as Raamen Hayashida and Nihon Abura Tou plus a production division, while the restaurant business includes stores such as CONA and Shumai no Joe and a licensing division. Seiki Aoyagi founded it in 2009, and it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
